summary: Nation.Cymru reported on 5 June 2026 that Troi'r Llanw / Turning the Tide had been awarded 1,499,800 pounds over three years from The National Lottery Community Fund's Climate Action Fund. Led by the Centre for Alternative Technology with Cwmpas, Youth Cymru, Mentrau Iaith Cymru and the Ethnic Minorities and Youth Support Team Wales, it set out to build a bilingual Wales-wide network of community climate initiatives, train environmental champions and create an advice hub, with a focus on underrepresented communities.
title: Troi'r Llanw / Turning the Tide: Centre for Alternative Technology leads a 1.5 million pound Wales-wide community climate action programme
